mapper.insert: INSERT INTO statistics_flow (user_id, flow, total_flow, time, created_time) SELECT current.user_id, CASE WHEN previous.total_flow BETWEEN 0 AND current.total_flow THEN current.total_flow - previous.total_flow ELSE current.total_flow END, current.total_flow, #{label}, #{createdMs} FROM ( SELECT id AS user_id, CASE WHEN MAX(0, in_flow) > 9223372036854775807 - MAX(0, out_flow) THEN 9223372036854775807 ELSE MAX(0, in_flow) + MAX(0, out_flow) END AS total_flow FROM user ) current LEFT JOIN statistics_flow previous ON previous.id = ( SELECT prior.id FROM statistics_flow prior WHERE prior.user_id = current.user_id ORDER BY prior.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM statistics_flow sample WHERE sample.user_id = current.user_id AND sample.created_time >= #{hourStartMs} AND sample.created_time < #{hourEndMs} )
